description: Link preview: returns the title, description, preview image, site name, favicon, canonical URL, and Open Graph/Twitter card details for one URL, like a chat app's link unfurl. Useful when an agent posts, shares, or summarizes links and needs clean metadata without reading the whole page. Not charged if the page can't be fetched. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

url.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL to preview.
